scopeHint.group: The button gets a fixed place in the group, like other widgets.
scopeHint.float: The button floats above the page content.
scopeHint.header: The button appears on the right of the Dashboard header. If the header is hidden in the Dashboard settings, it floats at the top right.

field.label: Label
field.offsetSeparate: Set side and top/bottom distance separately
field.closeOnSelect: Close the menu after a selection
field.overlay: Dim the page while the menu is open

hint.positionGroup: Relative to the widget's area in the group.
hint.background: “Dashboard” uses the primary color of the Dashboard theme. The icon color adapts automatically.
hint.label: Optional text next to the icon.
hint.visible: Both can also be changed at runtime with a message.
hint.zIndex: Increase it if other elements cover the button.
hint.id: Sent as msg.action and used by messages (patch/remove). New actions derive it from the label.
hint.icon: From PrimeIcons, Material Design Icons (as in the other Dashboard widgets) or your own image – upload it or link it in the “Own image” tab.
hint.closeIcon: Replaces the icon while the menu is open. “Keep icon” leaves the normal icon in place.
hint.direction: “Automatic” opens away from the nearest screen edge. Only directions that fit the style and position are offered.

row.label: Row
row.hint: Round icon buttons in a row

row-labels.label: Row with text
row-labels.hint: Separate buttons with icon and label, side by side or stacked

list.label: Menu list
list.hint: One panel with labelled rows, like a menu

semi-circle.label: Half circle
semi-circle.hint: Icon buttons on a half circle around the button

quarter-circle.label: Quarter circle
quarter-circle.hint: Icon buttons on a quarter circle – fits a corner well

circle.label: Circle
circle.hint: Icon buttons on a full circle – needs room all around

color.dashboardHint: Primary color of the Dashboard theme
color.autoHint: Light or dark to match the background color
color.hexHint: Color as hex, e.g. #2563eb – with 8 digits also transparent, e.g. #2563eb80

icon.imageIntro: Your own symbols as SVG, PNG, WebP, GIF or JPG – upload them or link them by address.
icon.imageTips: Like the other icons the image is tinted in the icon color – single-color symbols with a transparent background (SVG) work best. Uploaded images are stored in the flow (max. {{kb}} KB). An address like /icons/lamp.svg points to the httpStatic folder of Node-RED.
icon.unavailable: Material Design Icons are not available (Dashboard package not found).
icon.more: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} – type to narrow the search.
icon.errType: Please choose an SVG, PNG, WebP, GIF or JPG file.
icon.errSize: The image has {{size}} KB, at most {{kb}} KB are allowed. Tip: use SVG or save the image smaller.
icon.errRead: The file could not be read.
icon.errUrl: Please enter an address starting with /, http:// or https:// (no spaces or quotes).

actions.empty: No actions yet. Use “Add action” to create the first one.
actions.messagesHint: Actions and appearance can also be changed at runtime by message – replace, change single ones, remove, reset, even for one browser only. Examples and all fields are in the node help (book icon in the sidebar) under Input.

preserved.text: This node has design values that are no longer shown here (from an earlier version or an example flow):
preserved.drop: Remove them and use the Dashboard theme

err.unavailable: The editor could not be loaded: {{message}}
err.icon: Unknown icon or invalid image address – please pick it again in the icon field.
err.color: Please pick a color or enter a hex value like #2563eb.
err.idFormat: Only letters, digits and _ . : - are allowed, starting with a letter or digit, at most 64 characters.
err.dupId: Another action already uses this ID.
err.depth: The JSON is nested too deeply.
err.configSize: The configuration is too large overall. Please shrink actions or payloads.
err.selectPages: Please select at least one page.

preview.hint: Preview – click the button to try it.
preview.hintOpen: Click an action, or next to the menu to close it.
preview.disabled: The button is disabled (Advanced tab), so it does not open.
preview.invisible: The button is hidden (Advanced tab) and does not appear in the dashboard.
preview.examples: Example actions are shown until you add your own in the Actions tab.
preview.sent: A click on “{{label}}” sends msg.action = "{{id}}" with the action's payload.
preview.sentExample: “{{label}}” is only an example and sends nothing.
preview.title: Preview

pages.none: This dashboard has no pages yet.
pages.missing: {{count}} stored page(s) no longer exist; they are removed on save.

header.tip: Tip: small and transparent fits the other header icons best.
